depiction.subject: Museum board showing stupa forms and architectural diagrams
depiction.notes: Visible named forms include Ghantakara, Ghatakara, Bubbulakara, Dhanyakakara, Padmakara and Amalakaraka; lower diagrams show early/developed stupa plans and a circular caitya shrine.

vision_review.visual_notes: Six named dome/form typologies plus plan-development diagrams and a vatadage/circular caitya shrine section.
vision_review.uncertainty: Some Sinhala/Tamil labels and Latinized spellings are not fully legible; the board should not be treated as a strict chronological sequence without independent sourcing.

tag_review.notes: Routed as architectural visual lexicon, not chronology.

human_review.notes: Use as visual lexicon, not as standalone chronological proof.

fragment.caption: Planche muséale des formes de stupa : un vocabulaire de silhouettes — cloche, pot, bulle, tas de riz, lotus, myrobalan — complété par des schémas de plans anciens et développés.
fragment.what_it_shows: A modern museum typology of stupa morphology and related architectural plans.
fragment.why_here: Supports field reading of stupas already encountered in Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa.
fragment.limits: Modern explanatory synthesis; morphology alone does not date a monument or establish a linear evolution.

depiction.subject: Standing bronze figure with elaborate headdress and jewellery
depiction.period: undated museum object in current photograph
depiction.notes: Background didactic panel concerns asana/mudra vocabulary; exact object label is not visible.

vision_review.caption_transcription: ASANA visible on background panel; object caption not visible
vision_review.visual_notes: Standing metal figure, ornate crown/headdress, jewellery, right hand raised with fingers configured, left hand lowered; pedestal visible.
vision_review.uncertainty: Identity, date, provenance, school and precise mudra remain unresolved. Do not label as Avalokitesvara or a Hindu deity without catalogue evidence.

tag_review.notes: Object retained as unresolved iconographic field illustration pending catalogue evidence.

human_review.notes: Requires museum object label/catalogue before reader-facing identification.

fragment.caption: Bronze debout du Musée national de Colombo : l’objet montre une iconographie élaborée, mais son identité et sa datation restent volontairement ouvertes faute de cartel lisible.

fragment.why_here: Potentially useful for the Abhayagiri/Mahayana/Hinduism iconography thread once catalogue provenance is recovered.
